 # fixture repo
+
+## Running the tests
+
+Tests are run with [pytest](https://docs.pytest.org/) from the repository root:
+
+```bash
+pip install pytest
+pytest
+```
+
+Useful variations:
+
+```bash
+pytest -v                       # verbose, one line per test
+pytest test_pricing_cache.py    # a single file
+pytest -k reconcile             # tests matching a name
+```
+
+Note: no test files exist in this repo yet, so `pytest` currently collects
+nothing. Add `test_*.py` files at the root (or under a `tests/` directory) and
+they will be picked up automatically.
